limitations: Evidence: none of the 12 laws has a model of order 2, 6 or 10 (certified, CLM-C05-17), and the quasigroup laws 1076, 1110, 1279, 1286, 1313 none of order 10 (order 14 undecided). Spectra are closed under products, and a product has order 2 (mod 4) only if a factor has; the linear models of EXP-C05-07 have prime-power orders, odd or divisible by 4. The general form for all laws x = y*T is false (CLM-C05-18, law 474), so a proof must use more than the shape of the law. Twelve laws and two orders each are thin evidence; the statement is recorded to be tested, not as a finding.
statement: The laws 467, 501, 670, 677, 704, 907, 1076, 1083, 1110, 1279, 1286 and 1313 have no finite model of any order n = 2 (mod 4).
title: H-C05-J': none of the 12 open ETP laws x = y*T without a model of order 2 has a model of order n = 2 (mod 4)
